title: InformationAsset (catalogue instance schema)
description: Catalogue-instance projection of the metamodel InformationAsset entity. The normative field set is defined by the metamodel schema; this file mirrors it and adds only the catalogue-instance layer (evidence, provenance ladder, governance). Do not widen a normative enum here to accept a value the metamodel does not define: fix the record instead. A catalogue that diverges from the metamodel is a second source of truth. Classification is not a field on this record: it is asserted as dea:maps-to relationship instances into dea:information-class-* canonical ids (CR-IC-CAT-05 D-6 two-sided contract; Gate 6 validates them).

id.description: OpenDEAM-local identifier. The metamodel pattern is the general ^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*:[a-z0-9-]+$; this catalogue narrows it to the InformationAsset entity namespace so a record cannot be filed under another entity's identifier form (information-classes id precedent).

consumption_form.description: The form in which the information is consumed (metamodel normative field).

external_references.description: Identifiers in external systems. Never a substitute for the OpenDEAM id (E004).

evidence.description: Catalogue-instance layer. The producing source the asset was derived from; admission requires at least one source and a rationale.

kind.description: Kind of evidence: a path in a technehub-labs repository, an identified system of record, or a published document.

provenance.description: Catalogue-instance layer. Ladder passage from proposal to canonical admission (FOUNDATIONS admission ladder).

stage.description: Admission ladder stages (FOUNDATIONS D-4): candidate (proposed from evidence), corroborated (producing source verified), reviewed (steward review), canonical (admitted by CR).

date.description: ISO date (quoted in YAML so it stays a string).

actor.description: Authorship-bearing field: Emmanuel A. Otchere or TechNeHub Labs (AUT rules).

governance.description: Catalogue-instance layer. Ownership and review state.

relationships.description: Typed relationship instances asserted by this record (metamodel relationship-instance contract). Classification bindings are maps-to instances targeting dea:information-class-* ids; mapping is required for maps-to (CR-2 §9). Lineage (derived-from) may be asserted only against canonical DataEntity ids; until that catalogue is populated, absence is honest.
